items.note: The proof's route is reproduced exactly: net change (JV+RG)x independent of a,c, the central coefficients |S∩T| mod 2 and (|S∩T|-1)/2 with the side cancellation, and the three stages giving (-y,x). The statement leaves h=100 and the neighbour rules (|S∩T|=1 for bits, even intersection for complex) unspecified, and calls the network 'XOR gates' while also covering the complex case.

It states the invariant stored = D_v applied to the logical array, the common frame commuting with a pointwise gate, and D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} with the route operator ε_w D_sink(ρ(w)) D_source(w)^{-1}, as at 804-825.

It has the right content: indicator tensor lines with <t_S,t_T>=|S∩T|-1, nested labels, the only loss at center 3->4 of size h, the telescoping sum Wm-2N, L=Ich and the ratios 100/539 and 101/539. The actual label assignment (the A,B,P,Q stage labels of eq:motif-labels and the residual table) is reduced to 'assign labels stage by stage', and the orthonormal-basis part over F_2 is omitted.

The plan gives s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b<W_b m, the rank-one exception 2P_{U_a} at the N sources and the resulting shear H<-H+D on every role. It never assigns the projections P_U to gates and sinks, never states the endpoint identity M_sink(ρ(w))-M_source(w)=I_m (only 'the endpoint condition'), and asserts rank = dimension change without the P_V-P_U argument.

It states the phase frames C_U and that each edge change is a product of one kernel aI+bX_v (or its inverse) per orthonormal residual vector, and the method names weight additivity mod 4. Missing are s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c<W_c m and the endpoint corrections that give C^{⊗m} on every role. No sub-step derives the proposition.

The bit half follows the paper: L_b/N<1/2, deficit N-2L_b>0, η_b=339/22587335000000>20·2^{-50}, then s/W<m^τ with τ=1-2^{-50}. The complex half (s_c<W_c m, η_c=73/19906842167500, hence s_c/W_c<m^σ) is never stated or derived; σ only appears as an assumed bound in S2.3.5 and S6.1.1.

The plan uses linear-time single-digit operations, cyclic row splits and controlled shifts, but never states the lemmas or their conditions, such as an offset computable in b^{O(1)} time or units prime to q.

The plan follows the elimination with topmost-row, rightmost pivots, the O(V) lower-triangular transforms, the conjugation of ΠD, and the update/interchange/update gadget with exactly a interchanges. The choice of the prime q avoiding the denominators is omitted, which is minor.

Each step of the proof is present: F_0 by a single-digit operation, the cyclic role split, Φ_M frames giving Φ_{I_m}, the three-update interchange, s calls of volume V/W, the recurrence, the geometric sum with both cases of a, and the O(V) fixed-tape parking.

It follows the paper's route: high digits joined into a row field of at least W^k rows at cost O(Vρ), base-m pieces costing O(V)Σa_j m^{jτ}, and padding [2^u] to [q^e]. The zero-row padding to a multiple of W^k (1684-1690) is not mentioned.

It has one kernel per residual vector, the inverse via (C^{-1})^{⊗f}=(-i)^f Z^{⊗f}C^{⊗f}Z^{⊗f}, GL(m,F_2) as row additions on whole slots, exactly s_c child calls on f=e/m axes, and H_0^{⊗D}=b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D. The conjugation P_M X_v P_M^{-1}=X_{Mv} appears only in words in the S2.1 method.

It reproduces the eight conditional additions and their cycles, the guard interval, δ_bad by the union bound, T_0S_0^{-1} permuting B, the swap-shift-unswap rotations and the repair by sorting only the extracted records, with the paper's time bound.

It has the node overhead O(V((eK)^τ+1)), the rows from the first q_0 chunks, children of volume V/W, the recurrence with leaves O(e), the internal and leaf sums, and the base-m pieces giving O(d^{λ'}). The step K≤e^{c/β} that turns the overhead into O(e^λ) is not shown.
It gives the O(Vd^{λ'}) layer, exact until one truncation, the guard widths from A(e)≤sA(e/m)+E with Δ=⌈C_0 d^{C_1}⌉=o(p), and the √2·2^{-p} truncation error from the row-sum-one argument.

It covers character cancellation by the halving shift, the DIF step, bit-reversed storage B_t with the reverse procedure giving F^+B^{-1}, grouped rounds, and the layout costs O(TpdK), O(Tp·pK^{τ-1}) and O(Tpℓd^{λ'}) with error √2ℓ2^{-p}, all as in the paper.
It has B_0=2^{4p}, the four products, the separation |h_j|≤r2^{2p}<B_0/2, centered residues with carries in {0,1}, negacyclic folding, the shift by p+ℓ and the cost O(rp log(rp)), matching the proof.
It keeps the common LB order, the normalization MF^+((F^-f)(F^-g)/r)=(f*g)/(rM), permutation commuting with the pointwise product, the error 3δ+η scaled by M, and the cost, all as in the paper.

The route is the paper's: the HvdH identity, N invertible, A=S', B_0=D'J'C with normalization 2^{-2α²}, permutations kept in the identity, the tensor form, and the line cost. The statement never defines P_s, P_t ((P_su)_j=u_{tj}, (P_tv)_k=v_{-sk}) and omits the axis-exposure cost O(Tpd²(1+ℓ^τ)).

Both identities and the proof steps are right: the coefficient check, F_q^+R_c=R_c^{-1}F_q^+ with t_i a unit mod s_i, and the convolution normalizations. The chirp a_j=exp(-πiΣs_i j_i²/t_i) is never written, and the conjugation route to RF_s^+ is not mentioned.
It has the exact fixed rationals, the sizes, α, γ, the prime intervals with η=1/(4d), disjointness, Bernoulli giving T/2<S<T, α^4θ_i>p, and the n^{o(1)} search, all as in the paper.
It has the isomorphism argument, the triangular formula b_i=a_i+μ_iΣ_{j<i}a_jP_j, the descending update order, the padding invariance, the split/merge cyclic shifts and the O(Tpd²(1+ℓ^τ)) cost.
It gives well-definedness, the diagonal isometry, the wrap check ζ^{k+l}(-1)^h=ζ^j, M_C=D_-ι^{-1}M_r(ιD_+f,ιD_+g)=(f*g)/T, and twist errors below 2·2^{-p}.

The source transform 2^γB_0QF_tA=RF_s, the six-step algorithm and the role of the two scales by S are all correct. The opposite procedure defined by conjugation and the input scaling of the digits by 2^{-b-2} are not stated.

Errors are tracked through contractions with disk margins: E_s=9·2^γTL, (3E_s+2), the final 448b·2^{-3b/4}<1/2 from S≤T<2^b, L<b and γ≤b/4, then rounding and carries. The intermediate ring and chirp bounds (5TL, 8TL) are folded in rather than stated.
It reproduces the table rows, the margins g_1..g_7 with min 2^{-181}=2κ, setup as o(V), the absorption of log powers into p^κ, and the schoolbook cutoff.
S0 says the bound refutes the n log n conjecture 'in this model', but never gives the eventual lower bound or the liminf T_A(n)/(n lg n)=0 that negates it.

errors.says: Method: each one of Π is realised by three updates around a single interchange.
errors.paper: Each one is realised by two updates around one interchange, D_j<-D_j+H_i, (H_i,D_j)<-(D_j,H_i), D_j<-H_i-D_j, three operations in all (S1.1.5.4 states this correctly).

errors.says: Motivation: the row field divisible by W^k is supplied for general arrays by the chunk's own high digits.
errors.paper: The high digits give a row field of range R=q^{2ρ}≥W^k. Divisibility comes from appending zero rows up to R'=W^k⌈R/W^k⌉<2R.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to O(n(lg n)^{1-κ}): bit network and rank saving, power-width then arbitrary-width interchange, complex network and phase frames, packed XORs and the layer recurrence, then synthetic transforms, convolution, resampling with chirp cancellation, assembly, exact recovery and the margin table. It thins out at the finite-network interfaces. The bit network's endpoint identity M_sink(ρ(w))-M_source(w)=I_m and the projection matrices behind it are never stated. The complex interface's count s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c<W_c m, its deficit η_c and its endpoint corrections are only assumed, so σ in S2.3.5 is used without derivation. The parameters h=100, N and m=h^3 are never given.

steps.note: The plan has the restoring exchange network and (x,y)->(-y,x), but never gives h=100, the triple-indexed banks X_a,Y_a, N=binom(h,3)^3 or m=h^3. Since these are part of the required content, the conservative verdict is mentioned.
It has the common frame per gate commuting with a pointwise gate, D_out S D_in^{-1}, and the edge cost as a change of frame D_vD_u^{-1}.
It has nondegenerate subspaces of an m-dimensional space built from tensor indicator lines, comparable labels on every edge, and the only decrease at center 3->4 of dimension h.
It says matrix rank equals dimension change on every edge except the N source edges, where 2P_{U_a} has rank one. The P_V-P_U argument behind it is not given.
It has the signed sum Wm-2N, L=Ich, the absolute sum Wm-2N+2L, and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
It has L/N=100/539 (bit) and 101/539 (complex), both below 1/2, and the deficit N-2L_b>0, so s_b<W_b m.

The consequence (Φ_{I_m}, the shear H<-H+D on every row) is stated. The identity M_sink(ρ(w))-M_source(w)=I_m, and the source and sink matrices -P_{U_a} and P_{U_a^⊥} behind it, are only alluded to as 'the endpoint condition'.
It has A=E_1ΠE_2, exactly a interchanges plus O(V), and s recursive calls per node as the sum of edge ranks.
It has children of volume V/W, F_k≤(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), η_b>20·2^{-50} with m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20·2^{-50})>m(1-η) (log m<20 is used implicitly), τ=1-2^{-50}, and F_k=O(e^τ).

central.summary: The plan reconstructs seven of the nine steps: frames, labels, rank as dimension change, the budget, the strict saving L/N<1/2, edges as recursive calls, and the recurrence with τ=1-2^{-50}. It only alludes to the fixed network's parameters (h=100, N, m=h^3) and to the endpoint identity M_sink-M_source=I_m that makes the network a shear on every role.
